goals.title: G0 PSD roundtrip gate
goals.objective: Implement minimal scaffold and G0 PSD inventory/roundtrip evidence for all 17 templates; choose or block on PSD backend before product expansion.
goals.evidence: G0 passed with ag-psd. Added minimal TypeScript scaffold, PSD inventory/roundtrip scripts, validation docs, exact policy, manual checklist, and unit tests. Evidence: npm run typecheck passed; npm run psd:inventory inventoried 17 PSDs; npm run psd:roundtrip pass=true for 17 templates with total composite diff pixels=0; npm run test:unit passed 2 tests; artifacts in artifacts/g0/.

goals.title: Canonical contracts and adapters
goals.objective: Implement SourceAsset/SourceFrameSet/NormalizedFrameSet canonical contracts plus thin image/MeAegi source adapter boundaries and template adapter interface.
goals.evidence: Implemented canonical TypeScript contracts and thin adapters: packages/core SourceAsset/SourceFrameSet/NormalizedFrameSet/CanonicalFrame/MappingPlan/ValidationPolicy, normalization and export mapping guards; packages/source-adapters ImageUploadAdapter/PublicMeAegiAdapter emit generic SourceFrameSet only; packages/template-adapters PSD reader interface and ag-psd manifest-to-target mapping. Verification: npm run typecheck passed; npm run test:unit passed 5 tests.

goals.title: Core render validation export pipeline
goals.objective: Implement deterministic normalization, mapping/grouping/whole-avatar conversion planning, preview buffers, pixel diff validation, PSD export, and manual review bundle generation.
goals.evidence: Implemented core render/validation/export pipeline: alpha compositing and mapping preview in packages/render, exact RGBA pixel diff in packages/validation, PNG writer and review bundle PSD/sidecar export in packages/export. Review bundle includes PSD, mapping-plan.json, validation-report.json, validation-policy.json, preview PNGs, template inventory ref, manual checklist, and human-signoff.json. Verification: npm run typecheck passed; npm run test:unit passed 7 tests including review bundle export.

goals.title: Local web UI MVP
goals.objective: Implement import, all-part user mapping, grouping, all-animation previews, diff report, and export review bundle UI.
goals.evidence: Implemented local Vite/React UI MVP with import panel, every-source-part target mapping selectors, part/group/whole-avatar modes, grouped mapping indicator, source/converted animation previews, exact RGBA diff status, and export gating until all parts are confirmed. Verification passed: npm run typecheck; npm run test:unit (8/8 incl UI); npm run build.

goals.title: Fixtures and docs
goals.objective: Select representative MVP cody fixtures, document validation environment, validation policy, manual review/upload checklist, and show fixture results.
goals.evidence: Selected 5 representative MVP cody fixtures and implemented deterministic fixture validation. Added fixtures/mvp-cody-fixtures.json, scripts/validate-fixtures.ts, docs/fixture-results.md, docs/source-and-api-boundaries.md, updated fixture set/validation/manual review docs. Fixture run validates separated parts, weapon-to-gloves, grouped cape, whole-avatar-to-longcoat, and alpha accessory cases over 7 actions x 2 frames with exact RGBA diff 0. Verification passed: npm run typecheck; npm run fixtures:validate (5 fixtures pass=true); npm run test:unit (8/8).

goals.title: Final verification and review gate
goals.objective: Run required tests, ai-slop-cleaner, independent code review, and checkpoint final quality gate.
goals.evidence: Final quality gate passed: ai-slop-cleaner report updated; npm run typecheck; npm run test:unit 22/22; npm run psd:roundtrip 17 templates; npm run fixtures:validate 5 fixtures; npm run build; npm audit --audit-level=high 0 vulnerabilities; independent code-reviewer APPROVE and architect CLEAR.
